about: Judged search queries (#149 phase 1, PR 1; #156). Judgements are facts and owner decisions, never engine output. See tests/search/README section in README.md.

decisions.D1: San Diego shows the San Diego Fall showcase in Events, as a whole-word name match; order Teams, Events, Games.
decisions.D2: Owner, changed 2026-10-16: a city search also covers the rest of its county. City results first, then the rest of the county labelled nearby. Across sections too (owner, PR #157): a section with results in the named city itself comes before a section holding only nearby results; otherwise the place order Teams, Events, Games holds. A name match (Legends FC - Del Mar for Del Mar, San Diego Fall for San Diego) is a direct result, never nearby.
decisions.D3: LA = Los Angeles plus the whole word LA in names. LA Breakers required and first; La Roca FC never; LAFC So Cal neither required nor forbidden (LA and Los Angeles); Louisiana dropped.
decisions.D4: Partial-only queries (Surf Cup): Surf teams labelled partial match plus a no-match note; never San Diego Fall, never a Surf Sports Park field row.
decisions.D5: Clubs vs clubs with a season: one pairing row per age group in which they met; Slammers = clubs 96 and 1656; Blues = club 98.
decisions.D6: A field is a normalised name plus zip, with aliases. Great Park @ 92618 = 12 complex IDs; 60 Acres = 60 Acres Park @ 98052; Great Park field 15 shows only Field 15 games; Field 08 = Field 8.
decisions.D6a: Complex 3069 Orange County Great Park Sports Park is the same field as Great Park @ 92618.
decisions.D7: Useful for a broad name (Slammers): any current team of Slammers FC (96).
decisions.D8: Richmond: Richmond United (a name match) first, then the Finals held in Richmond VA; nothing for Richmond CA. D8 overrides D2 (owner, PR #157): Richmond means Richmond VA only, and Contra Costa County clubs are never nearby for it.
decisions.D9: Today's search is vendored into tests/search/engines/today.js, compared with index.html, retired explicitly.
decisions.D10: One sub-issue per PR, closed by that PR; #149 is referenced as Part of #149 only.
decisions.D11: A birth year also matches a 2026-27 two-year division whose squad was born the other year: ranked lower, never forbidden.
decisions.D12: Phoenix: all current teams of 592, 3716 and 1141 in Teams, one of each in the first 8 rows, no order among them; then Phoenix Spring within the first 6 event rows.
decisions.D13: Sting Black / Royal swapped names: the squad with the name now ranks first; earlier holders are allowed, never forbidden.
decisions.D14: Owner, 2026-10-16 (#163 Q1): Northwest 2023-24 also shows the Northwest Elite FC teams, the name they had that season (design rule 3, keep ambiguity); the Northwest 2023-24 conference season still comes first.
